{{Quote|Our true king has been ''silenced''. The one you recognize is a ''traitor'' and a Separatist minion.|[[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]]|<ref name="A War on Two Fronts">{{TCW|A War on Two Fronts}}</ref>}}
'''Sanjay Rash''', self-stylized as '''His Royal Majesty King Sanjay Rash''', was a tyrannical [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and had ties with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist Alliance]].

==Biography==
===Rise to power===
[[File:Onderon-TCW.png|left|thumb|250x250px|[[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], Rash's homeplanet.]]
Sanjay Rash was a young<ref name=":1">{{SWE|characters|king-ramsis-dendup|King Ramsis Dendup}}</ref> [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> native from [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]],<ref name="ency">{{SWE|characters|king-sanjay-rash|King Sanjay Rash}}</ref> a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide">''[[Knights of the Old Republic Campaign Guide]]''</ref>

In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> a [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|political crisis]] that had been plaguing the galaxy for a decade degenerated into an open conflict known as the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones">{{Film|II}}</ref> While normally allied with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]], the King of Onderon [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] regarded both sides as inherently corrupt and thought the best course of action for Onderon would be to remain unaligned.<ref name=":2">{{TCW|Front Runners}}</ref> Recognizing the winds of change in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]],<ref name=":5">{{SWE|locations|onderon|Onderon}}</ref> Sanjay Rash knew better. To ensure Onderon's prosperity and strength in the shifting galaxy would require a strong alliance -- and that meant striking an accord with the Separatists. Through methods cloaked in intrigue,<ref name="ency" /> a local coup was secretly backed by the Separatists.<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date" /> Rash assumed the crown of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], deposing Dendup<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> through the [[Treaty of Iziz]]<ref name="Twitter Proclamation">{{Twitter|TheCloneWars|status/258992510557360128|[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'']]|quote=The King of Onderon has spoken. What is your take on the Onderon Rebels: Patriots or Traitors? #CloneWars|archivedate=20190722193302}}</ref> and branding him a powerless old crone.<ref name="ency" /> He took the title name of "His Royal Majesty King Sanjay Rash",<ref name="Twitter Proclamation" /> a similar title held previuosly by Dendup.<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.46">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars Comic 6.46|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' Comic 6.46]]</ref>
[[File:Saw_gerrera_detail.png|thumb|339x339px|[[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]], the man who mainly opposed Rash and supported [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]].]]
Rash then allowed the Separatists to establish a firm foothold,<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> believing that isolationism would only lead to [[Onderonian/Legends|Onderonian]] stagnation<ref name=":1" /> and cementing his rule of the planet.<ref name="ency" /> General [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]] supported the new king despite his misgivings of offworld interlopers interfering in Onderonian affairs. The [[Onderonian/Legends|people]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]], though, began to reject Rash's rule,<ref name=":4" /> as they preferred the neutral stance championed by former monarch.<ref name=":5" /> An insurgency began targeting the battle droid forces stationed on the planet,<ref name=":4">{{SWE|characters|general-tandin|General Tandin}}</ref> refusing to acknowledge the legitimacy of his rule. [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]], a loyal follower of Dendup, would not tolerate Rash's Separatist-backed regime, which prompted him to join the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]].<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> Rash saw them as terrorists and refused to negotiate with them.<ref name="ency" /> He signed a [[Sanjay Rash's Royal Proclamation|Royal Proclamation]] that criminalized them, requesting his people to immediately notify any actions that were suspected to be terrorism to the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Security Droid legions]] posted within the city of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name="Twitter Proclamation" />

By [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]]<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date">{{FactFile2014|44|20 BBY 43-46|Liberation of Onderon}}</ref> King Rash lived a life of privilege within the polished walls of the royal residence, eyeing the actions of his subjects from the lofty heights of the palace balconies.<ref name="ency" /> His [[Bivall/Legends|Bivall]]<ref name=":3">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep503|text="Front Runners" &ndash; ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> royal adviser [[Okalin/Legends|Okalin]] kept him abreast of all developments within the walls of [[Iziz/Legends|Iziz]].<ref name="ency" /> He kept the deposed king [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Dendup]] in the [[Unifar Temple/Legends|Unifar Temple]]'s garden, isolating from having any visitor.<ref name=":2" />

===Rebellion===
[[File:OnderonRoyalGuard-FR.png|thumb|250x250px|Sanjay Rash controlled [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] from his [[Throne/Legends|throne]] room.|left]]
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="A War on Two Fronts Date" /> while looking over his vast kingdom from his royal residence,<ref name=":3" /> Rash received words that his royal carriage was attacked<ref name=":2" /> - an attempt on his life.<ref name=":3" /> As result he ordered the [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|commando droids]] to escort his predecessor to the [[Throne/Legends|throne]]. When Dendup arrived, he berated the former king, blaming him for the increase in activity by the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]]. He insisted that Dendup had to call off the attacks. Dendup retorted that Rash was dealing with the will of the people and it was up to the king to "embrace, bend, or break it," and Dendup could not as he was no longer the king. Rash reiterated that Dendup had to call off the attacks, or else, Dendup would atone with his life. Dendup responded that Rash had to end the attacks, by ending the droid occupation.<ref name=":2" />

The same night the rebels made an attack on the city's power generator, disabling it for good. Without power, the droids were unable to recharge and would eventually be disabled one by one. With the darkness as their cover, the rebels were able to ambush battle droid patrols with ease. The rebels' actions made Rash even more distraught, and he demanded better [[Troop/Legends|troops]] from [[Count/Legends|Count]] Dooku. The count, although displeased for the king's ability to not take care of the rebels, agreed to send more reinforcements, and also send a super tactical droid named [[Kalani/Legends|Kalani]] to succeed where the king had failed.<ref name=":2" />

As the Onderon rebels continued their strikes against the droids in the city, Rash prepared to act against them. Back in the palace, [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]] identified [[Steela Gerrera/Legends|Steela]] and [[Saw Gerrera/Legends|Saw Gerrera]] as well as [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] as the key members of the rebels. General Tandin suggested that the [[Royal Onderon Militia/Legends|Royal Onderon Militia]] be allowed to handle the rebels, but Kalani refused, suspecting that the militia could have rebel sympathizers among them. Rash was getting more and more frustrated, and called Dendup again to his throne and ordered his predecessor to stop the attacks. Once again, Dendup denied that he had no part in the rebels' doings and said it was the will of the people that justified their actions. The King was done with the [[Terrorist/Legends|terrorist]]'s acts and ordered Dendup's [[Death/Legends|execution]] the next [[Standard day/Legends|day]], hoping it would break the rebels' morale and stop the attacks.<ref name=":2" />

===Downfall===
{{Quote|What about-- Ugh!|Rash's final words|<ref name=":0" />}}
[[File:Tandin_holds_Rash_at_lance_point_Onderon.jpg|thumb|250x250px|Rash is betrayed by General [[Tandin/Legends|Tandin]], who sides with the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]].]]
The next day, Rash planned on publicly executing Dendup, along with Saw, who was captured attempting to rescue the deposed king. It was Rash's intention to demoralize the rebellion, as well as capture the rebels who attempt to rescue him. As soon as the rebels made their move, they were surrounded by droids and forced to surrender. But before Rash could proceed with the execution, Tandin and the military chose to rescue the rebels, having been convinced by Saw that Rash was not acting in Onderon's best interest. Tandin held Rash hostage, allowing Dendup, the rebels and his men to flee, even as Rash reminds the general that he'll be killed once he releases him. However, [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] emerged from the crowd and used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to knock down the droids, enabling Tandin and herself to escape. Rash's droids attempted pursuit, but the populace chose to impede them, openly declaring their support to the rebellion.<ref name=":6">{{TCW|The Soft War}}</ref> [[File:King_Rash_Tipping_Points_Execution.png|thumb|250px|The execution of King Rash.|left]]The rebels soon prepared for their final battle to take back the planet. Rash and Kalani sent a large force of battle droids and [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|Heavy Missile Platform droid gunships]] to combat them. While the rebels were outnumbered, they seemed to have the upper hand, managing to destroy the gunships with rocket launchers. After this final skirmish, Dooku contacted Rash and Kalani. Rash quickly explained what had happened and that they would need even more help to defeat the rebels. Dooku coldly refused, not wanting another war to deal with. He commanded Kalani to call back all of the droid forces from the planet. As Rash angrily protested, Kalani shot the deluded king, killing him and ending<ref name=":0">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref> his opportunistic reign.<ref>{{SWE|1=characters|2=general-kalani|3=General Kalani}}</ref>

===Legacy===
With the final death of Rash, the Confederacy droids retreated from Onderon, freeing the planet and having [[Ramsis Dendup/Legends|Ramsis Dendup]] reclaim his rightful place as the king.<ref name=":0" />

==Personality and traits==
[[File:SanjayRashpoints-FrontRunners.png|thumb|right|300px|King Sanjay Rash was selfish and arrogant in his station.]]
Far more decisive than Dendup,<ref name=":5" /> Sanjay Rash was a selfish and cruel leader, having made citizens riot and protest against his Separatist occupation in the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name=":6" /> Rash was also arrogant, considering himself to be the true king of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] when he was really a puppet of the Confederacy.<ref name="A War on Two Fronts" /> Regardless, he was so paranoid and afraid of losing his power that he believed Dendup was orchestrating the Onderon rebels despite being imprisoned and having no ability to communicate outside his confinement, ignoring Dendup's words that he was innocent and that the attacks were the will of the people, not his own, even as Rash demanded Dendup order the rebels to stand down.<ref name=":2" />

==Behind the scenes==
King Sanjay Rash is voiced in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series by [[Kirk Thornton]].<ref name=":2" />

King Sanjay Rash's design heavly featured Roman influences, including a headband that suggested gilded laurel leaves at his temples.<ref name=":3" />
